note: Which Kalshi series feed which transmission chains. 'status' says whether the series ticker has been checked against Kalshi. Run `python3 collect.py discover --search <words>` to find or confirm tickers before freezing.

series.label: Fed rate decision at the next FOMC meeting
series.status: confirmed: ticker seen on kalshi.com market pages (e.g. KXFEDDECISION-26SEP)
series.why: How sharply the market re-priced the next Fed decision this week. A big repricing means rates expectations moved fast, which drives Treasury volatility, swap hedging and refunding waves.

series.label: Monthly CPI change
series.why: Market expectation going into the CPI release; a large repricing flags an inflation surprise risk for rates.

series.label: Government shutdown on a given date
series.status: confirmed: ticker seen on kalshi.com (e.g. KXGOVSHUT-26JAN31)
series.why: Probability and date of a funding lapse feed the rubric's certainty and timing.

series.label: Government shutdown by a deadline
series.status: confirmed: ticker seen on kalshi.com (e.g. KXSHUTDOWNBY-26DEC31)
series.why: Backup to KXGOVSHUT when no single-date market is open.

series.label: Debt ceiling / US Treasury payment risk
series.status: to find: no ticker confirmed yet; only listed when Congress is near a debt-limit deadline
series.why: Probability that the debt limit is not raised by the X-date feeds certainty; the X-date feeds timing.

series.label: US recession this year
series.why: Context on the card only; not scored until tested.
